00cb61ee1dd8.en: The heroic tale of a man on the coasts of Aldemeri who grew up with three girls he loved and had 20 children with them. The Lishies ate them all in a single day, while the men were out hunting.
00cb61ee1dd8.t: Kisah heroik seorang lelaki di pantai Aldemeri yang membesar dengan tiga gadis yang dicintainya dan mendapat 20 anak bersama mereka. Lishies memakan mereka semua dalam satu hari, semasa kaum lelaki keluar memburu.

020aa5e65f19.en: She hid in the forest, waited for them to leave, then broke into the house and stole the stone along with their notes. Back in her village, she was the first to choose the surgery, because more than anything she wanted to stop grieving the disappearance of her parents. A mostly purple stone was implanted in her heart, which let her take revenge on the male Buhraies. But her emotions went awry, and she took her own life a few days later.
020aa5e65f19.t: Dia bersembunyi di hutan, menunggu mereka pergi, kemudian memecah masuk rumah itu dan mencuri batu itu bersama nota mereka. Kembali ke kampungnya, dia yang pertama memilih pembedahan itu, kerana lebih daripada segalanya dia mahu berhenti berduka atas kehilangan ibu bapanya. Batu yang kebanyakannya ungu ditanam di jantungnya, yang membolehkannya membalas dendam ke atas Buhraies jantan itu. Tetapi emosinya menjadi kacau, dan dia membunuh diri beberapa hari kemudian.

03580f15460a.en: Consumed by vengeance, he paired with a mostly red Walking Heart stone. With pure rage coursing through his blood, he killed hundreds of Lishies and was one of the first to set back the Lishies' advance. But rage fueled his heart, and he became a berserker, completely losing himself: he hunted in the forest and ripped apart anyone in his path, until other heroes had to hunt him down and destroy the stone that had replaced his heart.
03580f15460a.t: Dikuasai dendam, dia berpasangan dengan batu Walking Heart yang kebanyakannya merah. Dengan kemarahan tulen mengalir dalam darahnya, dia membunuh beratus-ratus Lishies dan antara yang pertama menyekat kemaraan Lishies. Tetapi kemarahan menyemarakkan jantungnya, dan dia menjadi pengamuk, langsung hilang diri: dia memburu di hutan dan mengoyakkan sesiapa di laluannya, sehingga wira lain terpaksa memburunya dan memusnahkan batu yang menggantikan jantungnya.

045cc4cc0325.en: The story of a general and his battalion who decided to blow up the road up the Buhraies Plains South Dip, and of how many lives they saved by making Sanbi's advance harder.
045cc4cc0325.t: Kisah seorang jeneral dan batalionnya yang memutuskan untuk meletupkan jalan mendaki Buhraies Plains South Dip, dan berapa banyak nyawa yang mereka selamatkan dengan menyukarkan kemaraan Sanbi.

05dd2b78374f.en: When they died, they were cremated with Wood People wood, and their ashes were spread across the land for good luck. Tolerideme is what it is today because of what they did.
05dd2b78374f.t: Apabila mereka meninggal, mereka dibakar dengan kayu Wood People, dan abu mereka ditabur di seluruh tanah untuk tuah. Tolerideme menjadi seperti hari ini kerana apa yang mereka lakukan.

07db6c2531b7.en: A comprehensive book on the many ways to extract valuables from beasts.
07db6c2531b7.t: Buku lengkap tentang pelbagai cara mendapatkan barang berharga daripada makhluk buas.

0ab0f041d94d.en: The story of the man who discovered Nari worms and nari gels, and used the gels to make poisons and other things that wreaked havoc on the ancient species.
0ab0f041d94d.t: Kisah lelaki yang menemui Nari worms dan nari gel, dan menggunakan gel itu untuk membuat racun dan benda lain yang memusnahkan spesies purba.

0b0bb390a9d8.en: 19 more entries on this page are only in <button class="linklike" data-go-bts>Behind The Scenes</button>.
0b0bb390a9d8.t: 19 lagi entri di halaman ini hanya ada dalam <button class="linklike" data-go-bts>Di Sebalik Tabir</button>.

0eb733137845.en: Some humans covered themselves in dirt and leaves to stay out of sight and spread out, living in the forests while they looked for a way to escape. That's how they discovered the East Dip: a cliff with faults they could use to shorten the climb down and soften its steepness. Over a few years, they gradually weakened the cliff until it collapsed. With that, humans were freed from the Buhraies' fangs, and fell into the hungry mouths of the Lishies.
0eb733137845.t: Sesetengah manusia menutup badan dengan tanah dan daun supaya tidak kelihatan dan tersebar, tinggal di hutan sambil mencari jalan untuk melarikan diri. Begitulah mereka menemui East Dip: tebing dengan rekahan yang boleh mereka gunakan untuk memendekkan penurunan dan mengurangkan kecuramannya. Dalam beberapa tahun, mereka secara beransur-ansur melemahkan tebing itu sehingga runtuh. Dengan itu, manusia bebas daripada taring Buhraies, dan jatuh ke dalam mulut lapar Lishies.

10871125d3e1.en: With her natural dexterity and analytical mind, she paired with a blue and green Walking Heart stone, which gave her full control of the bow and extra intelligence, and she began leading small armies against the Lishies, strategically and with great success. But she overstressed her body without feeding it enough emotions, and one day she dropped dead. (Nari stones were only discovered years later.)
10871125d3e1.t: Dengan ketangkasan semula jadi dan minda analitikalnya, dia berpasangan dengan batu Walking Heart biru dan hijau, yang memberinya kawalan penuh ke atas busur dan kecerdasan tambahan, dan dia mula memimpin tentera kecil menentang Lishies, secara strategik dan dengan kejayaan besar. Tetapi dia terlalu membebankan badannya tanpa memberinya cukup emosi, dan suatu hari dia mati mengejut. (Batu nari hanya ditemui bertahun-tahun kemudian.)

14ddd13f1fe9.en: Long before, the Buhraies had unchained the Wood People, who massacred humans across the Buhraies Plains over the years, until humans found a way to use some Wood People as a barrier against the others. The three ladies came onto the scene much later: one of the villages was led by them, who came up with scientific ways to farm the land better. It was not an easy job, and the stress made them binge eat and gain weight quickly. As the successful villages around what is now Tolerideme grew stable, people looked up to them, and roundness became the norm.
14ddd13f1fe9.t: Lama sebelum itu, Buhraies telah melepaskan Wood People, yang membunuh beramai-ramai manusia di seluruh Buhraies Plains selama bertahun-tahun, sehingga manusia menemui cara menggunakan sesetengah Wood People sebagai penghadang terhadap yang lain. Tiga wanita itu muncul jauh kemudian: salah sebuah kampung dipimpin oleh mereka, yang menghasilkan cara saintifik untuk bertani dengan lebih baik. Ia bukan kerja mudah, dan tekanan membuatkan mereka makan berlebihan dan cepat naik berat badan. Apabila kampung-kampung yang berjaya di sekitar tempat yang kini Tolerideme menjadi stabil, orang memandang tinggi pada mereka, dan badan bulat menjadi kebiasaan.

15ea03deb410.en: The King of Tolerideme was starved to death.
15ea03deb410.t: Raja Tolerideme dibiarkan kebuluran sampai mati.

1a5acde43fa2.en: Characters: Freeish Paulin; Asa the Powerful; Adrian from North Tolerideme; Bijura Moacir.
1a5acde43fa2.t: Watak: Freeish Paulin; Asa the Powerful; Adrian dari North Tolerideme; Bijura Moacir.

1b9fd442b722.en: The heroic tale of sacrifice for the greater good: Machado, leading an army of 5,000, chose to flank Ganyrami instead of helping his brother in the frontal battle for the city. His brother died in a trap the enemy had set, along with most of his men, but in return Ganyrami fell and all the ancient species there were put to the sword, a special moment for humans. Machado never used a Walking Heart stone, since his sister died trying to use one.
1b9fd442b722.t: Kisah heroik pengorbanan demi kebaikan bersama: Machado, mengetuai tentera seramai 5,000, memilih untuk mengapit Ganyrami daripada membantu abangnya dalam pertempuran berdepan untuk bandar itu. Abangnya mati dalam perangkap yang dipasang musuh, bersama kebanyakan orangnya, tetapi sebagai balasan Ganyrami jatuh dan semua spesies purba di sana dibunuh dengan pedang, detik istimewa bagi manusia. Machado tidak pernah menggunakan batu Walking Heart, kerana adik perempuannya mati semasa cuba menggunakannya.

246deb53cc98.en: In 650 A.G., the courtroom scientists of the Gandew, Tolerideme and Sanbi Kingdoms met at the hidden base to plan the overthrow: Asa the Powerful for Gandew, Adrian from North Tolerideme for Tolerideme, and Bijura Moacir for Sanbi. They slowly conditioned the people to accept their ideas and stirred up revolts ("the stones were controlling the people"), until the kingdoms lost their grip on their people and could no longer go to war with each other. Then the rebellion truly began, and it toppled all three kingdoms:
246deb53cc98.t: Pada 650 A.G., saintis istana Kerajaan Gandew, Tolerideme dan Sanbi bertemu di pangkalan rahsia untuk merancang penggulingan: Asa the Powerful untuk Gandew, Adrian dari North Tolerideme untuk Tolerideme, dan Bijura Moacir untuk Sanbi. Mereka perlahan-lahan membiasakan rakyat untuk menerima idea mereka dan mencetuskan pemberontakan (“batu-batu itu sedang mengawal rakyat”), sehingga kerajaan-kerajaan hilang genggaman ke atas rakyat dan tidak lagi boleh berperang antara satu sama lain. Kemudian pemberontakan sebenar bermula, dan ia menumbangkan ketiga-tiga kerajaan:

25e663f3d204.en: It all began when humans awoke on the islands of the Buhraies Plains. The green trees and peaceful nature contrasted with the pink and red trees that seemed to watch over them from all around.
25e663f3d204.t: Semuanya bermula apabila manusia terjaga di pulau-pulau Buhraies Plains. Pokok hijau dan alam yang aman berbeza dengan pokok merah jambu dan merah yang seolah-olah mengawasi mereka dari segenap penjuru.

2ec536d9fcc4.en: A teenage girl from a tribe seeking greater power was cornered by a group of male Buhraies. Seeing no choice, she gave in; they took her to their house and abused her. Her mind stayed strong, and she took mental notes of everything she saw, including strange stones in their basement. They let her go, since killing her would be work, especially the cleanup.
2ec536d9fcc4.t: Seorang gadis remaja dari puak yang mencari kuasa lebih besar telah dikepung oleh sekumpulan Buhraies jantan. Tiada pilihan, dia menyerah; mereka membawanya ke rumah mereka dan menderanya. Mindanya kekal kuat, dan dia mencatat dalam fikiran segala yang dilihatnya, termasuk batu-batu pelik di bilik bawah tanah mereka. Mereka melepaskannya, kerana membunuhnya akan menyusahkan, terutamanya membersihkannya.

35ded03f3590.en: A book arguing that the Darfaries were right to cleanse the mountain and set up the Goodbye Cliff, where Wozefaries and Sorefaries were sent flying toward Flatland. Gandew was the first king to rise.
35ded03f3590.t: Buku yang berhujah bahawa Darfaries betul membersihkan gunung dan mewujudkan Goodbye Cliff, tempat Wozefaries dan Sorefaries dilontar terbang ke arah Flatland. Gandew ialah raja pertama yang bangkit.

3aa535ce33e6.en: Summary written by AI from the author's notes (Novels.md). AI disclosure
3aa535ce33e6.t: Ringkasan ditulis oleh AI daripada nota pengarang (Novels.md). Pendedahan AI

3b26719c4c98.en: Characters: a male human; a female Buhraies.
3b26719c4c98.t: Watak: seorang lelaki manusia; seorang Buhraies betina.

40de5958f9b4.en: A legend tells of a young fisherman who claimed a massive Sanbi fish talked to him: "Humans taste good." He nearly soiled himself as the fish came closer. Then it smiled: "You look too young. Old humans taste the best! Hmmm… chewy skin! Give us chewy old people, and we give you our dumb young ones—yes!" The young fisherman faintly said, "Yes," and the massive fish disappeared into the depths.
40de5958f9b4.t: Satu legenda mengisahkan seorang nelayan muda yang mendakwa seekor ikan Sanbi yang besar bercakap dengannya: “Manusia rasa sedap.” Dia hampir terkencing dalam seluar apabila ikan itu mendekat. Kemudian ia tersenyum: “Kau nampak terlalu muda. Manusia tua paling sedap! Hmmm… kulit liat! Beri kami orang tua yang liat, dan kami beri kau yang muda dan bodoh dalam kalangan kami—ya!” Nelayan muda itu berkata perlahan, “Ya,” dan ikan besar itu hilang ke dalam laut dalam.

4ad8aa210fe5.en: The baby they had was sent back to the experimentation island, and it soon died. The couple kept trying, but every baby died soon after. The Buhraies took her revenge on the male and killed him, and only then discovered that the problem wasn't him, but the incompatibility between their races. She brought him back to life, but their love had died too: a fruit of love would never be born.
4ad8aa210fe5.t: Bayi yang mereka dapat dihantar kembali ke pulau eksperimen, dan tidak lama kemudian mati. Pasangan itu terus mencuba, tetapi setiap bayi mati tidak lama selepas itu. Buhraies itu membalas dendam ke atas lelaki itu dan membunuhnya, dan barulah dia mendapati masalahnya bukan lelaki itu, tetapi ketidakserasian antara bangsa mereka. Dia menghidupkannya semula, tetapi cinta mereka juga telah mati: buah cinta tidak akan pernah lahir.

5380ac2e0ea4.en: A book examining Triangle City and how bent it was on keeping everything under control. The title is a play on the word Freeish.
5380ac2e0ea4.t: Buku yang mengkaji Triangle City dan betapa taksubnya ia untuk mengawal segala-galanya. Tajuknya bermain dengan perkataan Freeish.

56860503eee9.en: Biology of the Darfaries, Wozefaries, and Sorefaries
56860503eee9.t: Biology of the Darfaries, Wozefaries, and Sorefaries

5c73dc29beeb.en: The books people read inside the world of Vraki, grouped by race.
5c73dc29beeb.t: Buku-buku yang dibaca orang di dalam dunia Vraki, dikumpulkan mengikut bangsa.

619bb3232dd1.en: Characters: the guilds of Triangle City (the three royal guilds that control the island are Ronaldo Lazyeye, Purple-Magina and Angry-Jin).
619bb3232dd1.t: Watak: persatuan-persatuan Triangle City (tiga persatuan diraja yang mengawal pulau itu ialah Ronaldo Lazyeye, Purple-Magina dan Angry-Jin).

6e94f0844b0e.en: A paradise of beautiful overlords who taught them and brought them all kinds of food soon turned into a brutal reality: humans were walking food rations for the Buhraies, and their blood tasted sweetest when they feared most for their lives. They ran around like wild game, until some figured out that the Wood People, as they came to call the pink and red trees, only looked frightening and did nothing (the Buhraies kept them chained with Fost stones). The Buhraies, though, seemed to attack at random, almost as if they enjoyed keeping humans on edge.
6e94f0844b0e.t: Syurga penguasa cantik yang mengajar mereka dan membawa pelbagai makanan tidak lama kemudian bertukar menjadi realiti kejam: manusia ialah catuan makanan berjalan bagi Buhraies, dan darah mereka paling manis apabila mereka paling takut akan nyawa. Mereka berlari ke sana sini seperti buruan liar, sehingga ada yang mendapati Wood People, seperti yang mereka panggil pokok merah jambu dan merah itu, hanya nampak menakutkan dan tidak berbuat apa-apa (Buhraies merantai mereka dengan Fost stone). Tetapi Buhraies nampaknya menyerang secara rawak, hampir seolah-olah mereka seronok membuatkan manusia sentiasa gelisah.

706d0dc00e97.en: An accountant's adventures in a company scheme that blew up and landed him in jail. Kind of like the Enron scandal, but with less partying: more like one guy silently trying to hoard all the balls for himself, like a dragon.
706d0dc00e97.t: Pengembaraan seorang akauntan dalam skim syarikat yang meletup dan menyebabkan dia dipenjarakan. Agak seperti skandal Enron, tetapi dengan kurang berparti: lebih seperti seorang lelaki yang diam-diam cuba menimbun semua bola untuk dirinya, seperti seekor naga.

754513ac44ac.en: A girl whose parents hid her the moment the Lishies struck and ate her entire village. She waited patiently for them to leave, then made her way through the forest from village to village, warning whoever she could, and saved many lives with her heroic act.
754513ac44ac.t: Seorang budak perempuan yang disembunyikan ibu bapanya sebaik sahaja Lishies menyerang dan memakan seluruh kampungnya. Dia menunggu dengan sabar sehingga mereka pergi, kemudian merentasi hutan dari kampung ke kampung, memberi amaran kepada sesiapa yang boleh, dan menyelamatkan banyak nyawa dengan perbuatan heroiknya.

763697ce850a.en: The books people read inside the world of Vraki, grouped by race. Many retell history as legend, like the story of humans escaping the Buhraies, or the tale of a man on the Aldemeri coast who turned his grief into revenge against the Lishies. Others are scholarly works, such as a study of Darfaries biology.
763697ce850a.t: Buku-buku yang dibaca orang di dalam dunia Vraki, dikumpulkan mengikut bangsa. Banyak yang menceritakan semula sejarah sebagai legenda, seperti kisah manusia melarikan diri daripada Buhraies, atau kisah seorang lelaki di pantai Aldemeri yang mengubah kesedihannya menjadi dendam terhadap Lishies. Yang lain karya ilmiah, seperti kajian tentang biologi Darfaries.

7786b1917d9c.en: A male human was tied down for a Buhraies to feed on, but he was more excited than afraid, for the Buhraies' beauty was a perfection of nature. As she fed, she felt his lewd aura tickling hers, so she bought him from the experimentation island and brought him home, where she kept healing and teasing him while she fed on him.
7786b1917d9c.t: Seorang lelaki manusia diikat supaya seekor Buhraies boleh makan daripadanya, tetapi dia lebih teruja daripada takut, kerana kecantikan Buhraies ialah kesempurnaan alam. Semasa dia makan, dia merasai aura lucah lelaki itu menggeletek auranya, jadi dia membelinya dari pulau eksperimen dan membawanya pulang, di mana dia terus menyembuh dan mengusiknya sambil makan daripadanya.

9156b1d0155c.en: In 640 A.G., an incredibly smart man named Freeish Paulin felt compelled to change things, so he began building a secret base in what is now Forway City to overthrow the kingdoms.
9156b1d0155c.t: Pada 640 A.G., seorang lelaki yang sangat bijak bernama Freeish Paulin rasa terpanggil untuk mengubah keadaan, jadi dia mula membina pangkalan rahsia di tempat yang kini Forway City untuk menggulingkan kerajaan-kerajaan.

9d11ac3533e6.en: Era: a "formal" book began making the rounds around ~640 A.G.; pieces of it were written earlier.
9d11ac3533e6.t: Era: buku “rasmi” mula tersebar sekitar ~640 A.G.; sebahagiannya ditulis lebih awal.

9d42c264ab52.en: The plan succeeded, and the courtroom scientists became the new kings. They wrote the Prosperity Treaty and Forway law so that no more wars over greed would break out between them. They created a common currency, formalized a calendar starting from the year Ganyrami fell, and built other tools to put everyone on the same page and make trade easier. Embassies were founded soon after, and all ruins and major cities became Forway property. Sundeath tried to stay out of it all, but gave in under the sheer pressure from Forway; in exchange, it has Pharaohs as city leaders.
9d42c264ab52.t: Rancangan itu berjaya, dan saintis istana menjadi raja baharu. Mereka menulis Perjanjian Kemakmuran dan undang-undang Forway supaya tiada lagi perang kerana ketamakan meletus antara mereka. Mereka mencipta mata wang bersama, memformalkan kalendar bermula dari tahun Ganyrami jatuh, dan membina alat lain untuk menyamakan pemahaman semua orang dan memudahkan perdagangan. Kedutaan diasaskan tidak lama kemudian, dan semua runtuhan dan bandar utama menjadi hak milik Forway. Sundeath cuba menjauhkan diri daripada semuanya, tetapi akur di bawah tekanan hebat daripada Forway; sebagai pertukaran, ia ada Firaun sebagai pemimpin bandar.

b350040ad42d.en: Characters: a male general, and a few more.
b350040ad42d.t: Watak: seorang jeneral lelaki, dan beberapa lagi.

b451fc9e74b2.en: The King of Sanbi was humiliated in public, spanked by many people, then dropped alive into the ocean.
b451fc9e74b2.t: Raja Sanbi dihina di khalayak ramai, dipukul punggung oleh ramai orang, kemudian dijatuhkan hidup-hidup ke dalam laut.

bb953b325c52.en: About the first king, Gandew, and how his teachings let the Darfaries thrive.
bb953b325c52.t: Tentang raja pertama, Gandew, dan bagaimana ajarannya membolehkan Darfaries berkembang maju.

bd67f0e97450.en: Gabiro Sundeath Scientist Presents. A deeper dive into Buhraies' Soul Analysis
bd67f0e97450.t: Gabiro Sundeath Scientist Presents. A deeper dive into Buhraies' Soul Analysis

ca36c6e3535b.en: The first book from Gabiro's Buhraies soul research: an old, tattered book with simple bindings and a golden, handwritten title. He wrote it while working in Sundeath, one of a few books of his that nobody seemed to care for. Gabiro argues that the Buhraies, the masters of the soul, really did clone people by splitting their souls in half, and that they also did the reverse, creating life from two or more sources: the core of how they extended their lifespans and gave existing specimens new traits. Entirely new specimens, like Bruntos and Naked Bruntos, came from tapping into the soul realm and binding souls to donor flesh. Harry reads it in Vol 2.
ca36c6e3535b.t: Buku pertama daripada penyelidikan jiwa Buhraies oleh Gabiro: buku lama yang lusuh dengan jilid ringkas dan tajuk emas tulisan tangan. Dia menulisnya semasa bekerja di Sundeath, antara beberapa bukunya yang nampaknya tiada siapa peduli. Gabiro berhujah bahawa Buhraies, pakar jiwa, benar-benar mengklon orang dengan membelah jiwa mereka dua, dan mereka juga melakukan sebaliknya, mencipta hidup daripada dua sumber atau lebih: teras bagaimana mereka memanjangkan jangka hayat dan memberi spesimen sedia ada sifat baharu. Spesimen yang benar-benar baharu, seperti Bruntos dan Naked Bruntos, datang daripada memanfaatkan alam jiwa dan mengikat jiwa kepada daging penderma. Harry membacanya dalam Jilid 2.

cf5c5bf23114.en: He told everyone what had happened; some fishermen did just that, and it worked. The story spread like wildfire, but it seems only the fisherman's relatives can catch Sanbi fish with ease. That family is now the biggest family in Sanbi.
cf5c5bf23114.t: Dia memberitahu semua orang apa yang berlaku; sesetengah nelayan berbuat begitu, dan ia berjaya. Kisah itu tersebar seperti api, tetapi nampaknya hanya saudara-mara nelayan itu yang boleh menangkap ikan Sanbi dengan mudah. Keluarga itu kini keluarga terbesar di Sanbi.

d1d673eb2fc3.en: A second book covers using Buhraies soul analysis to identify soul markers of different species, testing standards and so on. Gabiro also suggested using it for paternity tests or finding missing people, and maybe fingerprinting everyone for an alternate badge system. It just didn't fly.
d1d673eb2fc3.t: Buku kedua merangkumi penggunaan analisis jiwa Buhraies untuk mengenal pasti penanda jiwa spesies berbeza, piawaian ujian dan sebagainya. Gabiro juga mencadangkan menggunakannya untuk ujian paterniti atau mencari orang hilang, dan mungkin mengambil cap jari semua orang untuk sistem lencana alternatif. Cuma ia tidak diterima.

da01877b6e77.en: The King of Gandew was executed in front of everyone, calm and relieved despite it all. Only a few people know what he truly did.
da01877b6e77.t: Raja Gandew dihukum mati di depan semua orang, tenang dan lega walaupun begitu. Hanya segelintir orang tahu apa yang sebenarnya dia lakukan.

e6f49c0378bd.en: In 648 A.G., Paulin was betrayed and sold to the Gandew Kingdom to be assassinated. But as the King of Gandew learned what Paulin was trying to do, he came to agree with most of it, overthrowing the current kingdoms included, mainly because he realized that otherwise everyone would end up dead and nothing would be solved. He still had to have Paulin killed to save face with the people, but Paulin had given him all his connections, so the king began building a new base in what is now the Freeish Kingdom. He entrusted one of his closest allies (and mistresses) with leading the organization, and made her Courtroom Scientist under the guise of "better war preparations".
e6f49c0378bd.t: Pada 648 A.G., Paulin dikhianati dan dijual kepada Kerajaan Gandew untuk dibunuh. Tetapi apabila Raja Gandew mengetahui apa yang cuba dilakukan Paulin, dia akhirnya bersetuju dengan sebahagian besarnya, termasuk menggulingkan kerajaan-kerajaan semasa, terutamanya kerana dia sedar jika tidak semua orang akan mati dan tiada apa yang selesai. Dia masih terpaksa membunuh Paulin untuk menjaga air muka di depan rakyat, tetapi Paulin telah memberinya semua kenalannya, jadi raja itu mula membina pangkalan baharu di tempat yang kini Kerajaan Freeish. Dia mempercayakan salah seorang sekutu terdekatnya (dan perempuan simpanannya) untuk memimpin organisasi itu, dan menjadikannya saintis istana dengan berselindung di sebalik “persiapan perang yang lebih baik”.
